decisions.reason: Using console-split-chunks.txt the report explains that a dynamic import instantiates the whole module graph, sibling specifiers resolve relative to the fetched entry chunk URL, and the 404'd siblings were never shipped, so the 200 entry still ends in a rejected import() blamed on the entry URL. The fix is an isolated single-entry build with inlineDynamicImports producing one self-contained chunk (with a complete-ship alternative that accounts for every emitted dependency).

Report compares chunk-route.ts:15-20 with the ci-note.md debug values (LIB_DIR uppercase E:, realpath lowercase e:) and pinpoints the case-sensitive startsWith rejecting an actually contained file after realpathSync. It explains per-API why Linux passes (single legal spelling on a case-sensitive FS) and why the C: laptop matched by luck, and explicitly frames the failure as a deterministic API-casing mismatch rather than 'Windows paths are unreliable' or realpath always lowercasing.

Proposed guard canonicalizes both root and candidate with realpathSync, then uses path.relative with rejection of '', '..', '..'+sep and absolute results (different-drive caught by isAbsolute), noting win32 relative compares case-insensitively while POSIX stays case-sensitive and that symlink/junction escapes are resolved before comparison; preserves the application/javascript MIME type required for module fetch.

Explains one Ctrl+wheel WheelEvent dispatches through both the modal zoom listener and the pane font listener on the propagation path, that preventDefault only cancels the default action and ordering tricks fail under capture/window listeners, and gives the modal exclusive ownership: the pane handler bails when the modal owns the gesture while the modal preventDefaults and stops propagation with passive:false.

Planned checks cover all three incidents: self-contained-build/pack/e2e assertions that the import graph is deployable with code-block fallback on failure; containment tests with win32 case-mismatch serving while traversal, prefix-sibling, absolute and symlink escapes are refused (plus mocked lowercase realpath and a Windows CI job); and a modal Ctrl+wheel test asserting diagram zoom exactly once with unchanged pane font size and defaultPrevented.

caps.reason: The recommended fix strengthens containment (realpath canonicalization plus path.relative traversal/absolute rejection) rather than disabling it or serving paths outside the plugin lib root.
